title: Santa Barbara, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Santa Barbara, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Santa Barbara is a city in CA with a population of 92,000. American Riviera with Spanish colonial architecture, wine country, and stunning coastline. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
